texts.NIV84: When you sit to dine with a ruler, note well what is before you,
texts.KJV: When thou sittest to eat with a ruler, consider diligently what is before thee:
texts.NKJV:
When you sit down to eat with a ruler,
Consider carefully what is before you;
texts.DRB: When thou shalt sit to eat with a prince, consider diligently what is set before thy face.

texts.NIV84: and put a knife to your throat if you are given to gluttony.
texts.KJV: And put a knife to thy throat, if thou be a man given to appetite.
texts.NKJV:
And put a knife to your throat
If you are a man given to appetite.
texts.DRB: And put a knife to thy throat, if it be so that thou have thy soul in thy own power.

texts.NIV84: Do not crave his delicacies, for that food is deceptive.
texts.KJV: Be not desirous of his dainties: for they are deceitful meat.
texts.NKJV:
Do not desire his delicacies,
For they are deceptive food.
texts.DRB: Be not desirous of his meats, in which is the bread of deceit.

texts.NIV84: Do not wear yourself out to get rich; have the wisdom to show restraint.
texts.KJV: Labour not to be rich: cease from thine own wisdom.
texts.NKJV:
Do not overwork to be rich;
Because of your own understanding, cease!
texts.DRB: Labour not to be rich: but set bounds to thy prudence.

texts.NIV84: Cast but a glance at riches, and they are gone, for they will surely sprout wings and fly off to the sky like an eagle.
texts.KJV: Wilt thou set thine eyes upon that which is not? for riches certainly make themselves wings; they fly away as an eagle toward heaven.
texts.DRB: Lift not up thy eyes to riches which thou canst not have: because they shall make themselves wings like those of an eagle, and shall fly towards heaven.

texts.NIV84: Do not eat the food of a stingy man, do not crave his delicacies;
texts.KJV: Eat thou not the bread of him that hath an evil eye, neither desire thou his dainty meats:
texts.NKJV:
Do not eat the bread of a miser,
Nor desire his delicacies;
texts.DRB: Eat not with an envious man, and desire not his meats:

texts.NIV84: for he is the kind of man who is always thinking about the cost. "Eat and drink," he says to you, but his heart is not with you.
texts.KJV: For as he thinketh in his heart, so is he: Eat and drink, saith he to thee; but his heart is not with thee.
texts.NKJV:
For as he thinks in his heart, so is he.
“Eat and drink!” he says to you,
But his heart is not with you.
texts.DRB: Because like a soothsayer, and diviner, he thinketh that which he knoweth not. Eat and drink, will he say to thee: and his mind is not with thee.

texts.NIV84: You will vomit up the little you have eaten and will have wasted your compliments.
texts.KJV: The morsel which thou hast eaten shalt thou vomit up, and lose thy sweet words.
texts.NKJV:
The morsel you have eaten, you will vomit up,
And waste your pleasant words.
texts.DRB: The meats which thou hadst eaten, thou shalt vomit up: and shalt loose thy beautiful words.

texts.NIV84: Do not speak to a fool, for he will scorn the wisdom of your words.
texts.KJV: Speak not in the ears of a fool: for he will despise the wisdom of thy words.
texts.NKJV:
Do not speak in the hearing of a fool,
For he will despise the wisdom of your words.
texts.DRB: Speak not in the ears of fools: because they will despise the instruction of thy speech.

texts.NIV84: Do not move an ancient boundary stone or encroach on the fields of the fatherless,
texts.KJV: Remove not the old landmark; and enter not into the fields of the fatherless:
texts.NKJV:
Do not remove the ancient landmark,
Nor enter the fields of the fatherless;
texts.DRB: Touch not the bounds of little ones: and enter not into the field of the fatherless:

texts.NIV84: for their Defender is strong; he will take up their case against you.
texts.KJV: For their redeemer is mighty; he shall plead their cause with thee.
texts.NKJV:
For their Redeemer is mighty;
He will plead their cause against you.
texts.DRB: For their near kinsman is strong: and he will judge their cause against thee.

texts.NIV84: Apply your heart to instruction and your ears to words of knowledge.
texts.KJV: Apply thine heart unto instruction, and thine ears to the words of knowledge.
texts.NKJV:
Apply your heart to instruction,
And your ears to words of knowledge.
texts.DRB: Let thy heart apply itself to instruction: and thy ears to words of knowledge.

blocks.title: Do Not Let Your Heart Envy

texts.NIV84: Do not withhold discipline from a child; if you punish him with the rod, he will not die.
texts.KJV: Withhold not correction from the child: for if thou beatest him with the rod, he shall not die.
texts.NKJV:
Do not withhold correction from a child,
For if you beat him with a rod, he will not die.
texts.DRB: Withhold not correction from a child: for if thou strike him with the rod, he shall not die.

texts.NIV84: Punish him with the rod and save his soul from death.
texts.KJV: Thou shalt beat him with the rod, and shalt deliver his soul from hell.
texts.NKJV:
You shall beat him with a rod,
And deliver his soul from hell.
texts.DRB: Thou shalt beat him with the rod, and deliver his soul from hell.

texts.NIV84: My son, if your heart is wise, then my heart will be glad;
texts.KJV: My son, if thine heart be wise, my heart shall rejoice, even mine.
texts.NKJV:
My son, if your heart is wise,
My heart will rejoice—indeed, I myself;
texts.DRB: My son, if thy mind be wise, my heart shall rejoice with thee:

texts.NIV84: my inmost being will rejoice when your lips speak what is right.
texts.KJV: Yea, my reins shall rejoice, when thy lips speak right things.
texts.NKJV:
Yes, my inmost being will rejoice
When your lips speak right things.
texts.DRB: And my reins shall rejoice, when thy lips shall speak what is right.

texts.NIV84: Do not let your heart envy sinners, but always be zealous for the fear of the LORD.
texts.KJV: Let not thine heart envy sinners: but be thou in the fear of the Lord all the day long.
texts.NKJV:
Do not let your heart envy sinners,
But be zealous for the fear of the Lord all the day;
texts.DRB: Let not thy heart envy sinners: but be thou in the fear of the Lord all the day long:

texts.NIV84: There is surely a future hope for you, and your hope will not be cut off.
texts.KJV: For surely there is an end; and thine expectation shall not be cut off.
texts.NKJV:
For surely there is a hereafter,
And your hope will not be cut off.
texts.DRB: Because thou shalt have hope in the latter end, and thy expectation shall not be taken away.

blocks.title: Guide Your Heart in the Way

texts.NIV84: Listen, my son, and be wise, and keep your heart on the right path.
texts.KJV: Hear thou, my son, and be wise, and guide thine heart in the way.
texts.NKJV:
Hear, my son, and be wise;
And guide your heart in the way.
texts.DRB: Hear thou, my son, and be wise: and guide thy mind in the way.

texts.NIV84: Do not join those who drink too much wine or gorge themselves on meat,
texts.KJV: Be not among winebibbers; among riotous eaters of flesh:
texts.NKJV:
Do not mix with winebibbers,
Or with gluttonous eaters of meat;
texts.DRB: Be not in the feasts of great drinkers, nor in their revellings, who contribute flesh to eat:

texts.NIV84: for drunkards and gluttons become poor, and drowsiness clothes them in rags.
texts.KJV: For the drunkard and the glutton shall come to poverty: and drowsiness shall clothe a man with rags.
texts.NKJV:
For the drunkard and the glutton will come to poverty,
And drowsiness will clothe a man with rags.
texts.DRB: Because they that give themselves to drinking, and that club together shall be consumed; and drowsiness shall be clothed with rags.

texts.NIV84: Listen to your father, who gave you life, and do not despise your mother when she is old.
texts.KJV: Hearken unto thy father that begat thee, and despise not thy mother when she is old.
texts.NKJV:
Listen to your father who begot you,
And do not despise your mother when she is old.
texts.DRB: Hearken to thy father, that beget thee: and despise not thy mother when she is old.

blocks.title: Let Your Eyes Observe His Ways

texts.NIV84: Buy the truth and do not sell it; get wisdom, discipline and understanding.
texts.KJV: Buy the truth, and sell it not; also wisdom, and instruction, and understanding.
texts.NKJV:
Buy the truth, and do not sell it,
Also wisdom and instruction and understanding.
texts.DRB: Buy truth, and do not sell wisdom, and instruction, and understanding.

texts.NIV84: The father of a righteous man has great joy; he who has a wise son delights in him.
texts.KJV: The father of the righteous shall greatly rejoice: and he that begetteth a wise child shall have joy of him.
texts.NKJV:
The father of the righteous will greatly rejoice,
And he who begets a wise child will delight in him.
texts.DRB: The father of the just rejoiceth greatly: he that hath begotten a wise son, shall have joy in him.

texts.NIV84: May your father and mother be glad; may she who gave you birth rejoice!
texts.KJV: Thy father and thy mother shall be glad, and she that bare thee shall rejoice.
texts.NKJV:
Let your father and your mother be glad,
And let her who bore you rejoice.
texts.DRB: Let thy father, and thy mother be joyful, and let her rejoice that bore thee.

texts.NIV84: My son, give me your heart and let your eyes keep to my ways,
texts.KJV: My son, give me thine heart, and let thine eyes observe my ways.
texts.NKJV:
My son, give me your heart,
And let your eyes observe my ways.
texts.DRB: My son, give me thy heart: and let thy eyes keep my ways.

texts.NIV84: for a prostitute is a deep pit and a wayward wife is a narrow well.
texts.KJV: For a whore is a deep ditch; and a strange woman is a narrow pit.
texts.NKJV:
For a harlot is a deep pit,
And a seductress is a narrow well.
texts.DRB: For a harlot is a deep ditch: and a strange woman is a narrow pit.

texts.NIV84: Like a bandit she lies in wait, and multiplies the unfaithful among men.
texts.KJV: She also lieth in wait as for a prey, and increaseth the transgressors among men.
texts.NKJV:
She also lies in wait as for a victim,
And increases the unfaithful among men.
texts.DRB: She lieth in wait in the way as a robber, and him whom she shall see unwary, she will kill.

texts.NIV84: Who has woe? Who has sorrow? Who has strife? Who has complaints? Who has needless bruises? Who has bloodshot eyes?
texts.KJV: Who hath woe? who hath sorrow? who hath contentions? who hath babbling? who hath wounds without cause? who hath redness of eyes?
texts.NKJV:
Who has woe?
Who has sorrow?
Who has contentions?
Who has complaints?
Who has wounds without cause?
Who has redness of eyes?
texts.DRB: Who hath woe? whose father hath woe? who hath contentions? who falls into pits? who hath wounds without cause? who hath redness of eyes?

texts.NIV84: Those who linger over wine, who go to sample bowls of mixed wine.
texts.KJV: They that tarry long at the wine; they that go to seek mixed wine.
texts.NKJV:
Those who linger long at the wine,
Those who go in search of mixed wine.
texts.DRB: Surely they that pass their time in wine, and study to drink of their cups.

texts.NIV84: Do not gaze at wine when it is red, when it sparkles in the cup, when it goes down smoothly!
texts.KJV: Look not thou upon the wine when it is red, when it giveth his colour in the cup, when it moveth itself aright.
texts.DRB: Look not upon the wine when it is yellow, when the colour thereof shineth in the glass: it goeth in pleasantly,

texts.NIV84: In the end it bites like a snake and poisons like a viper.
texts.KJV: At the last it biteth like a serpent, and stingeth like an adder.
texts.NKJV:
At the last it bites like a serpent,
And stings like a viper.
texts.DRB: But in the end, it will bite like a snake, and will spread abroad poison like a basilisk.

texts.NIV84: Your eyes will see strange sights and your mind imagine confusing things.
texts.KJV: Thine eyes shall behold strange women, and thine heart shall utter perverse things.
texts.NKJV:
Your eyes will see strange things,
And your heart will utter perverse things.
texts.DRB: Thy eyes shall behold strange women, and thy heart shall utter perverse things.

texts.NIV84: You will be like one sleeping on the high seas, lying on top of the rigging.
texts.KJV: Yea, thou shalt be as he that lieth down in the midst of the sea, or as he that lieth upon the top of a mast.
texts.NKJV:
Yes, you will be like one who lies down in the midst of the sea,
Or like one who lies at the top of the mast, saying:
texts.DRB: And thou shalt be as one sleeping in the midst of the sea, and as a pilot fast asleep, when the stern is lost.

texts.NIV84: "They hit me," you will say, "but I'm not hurt! They beat me, but I don't feel it! When will I wake up so I can find another drink?"
texts.KJV: They have stricken me, shalt thou say, and I was not sick; they have beaten me, and I felt it not: when shall I awake? I will seek it yet again.
texts.DRB: And thou shalt say: They have beaten me, but I was not sensible of pain: they drew me, and I felt not: when shall I awake, and find wine again?
